entities.summary: Josh Huff is an American former professional football wide receiver. He played college football for the Oregon Ducks and was selected by the Philadelphia Eagles in the third round of the 2014 NFL draft. He was also a member of the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, New Orleans Saints, Arizona Hotshots, Calgary Stampeders, and Toronto Argonauts.
